observations.disturbance: Two independent coding workers implement disjoint methods under intentionally opposing list-versus-dictionary structural priors and partial L3 specification, creating incompatible shared internal representations that appear only when their outputs are integrated.
observations.treatment: The merger receives a richer shared L0 specification that exposes the common class contract while operating on the same split-worker outputs. This shared specification attenuates the representation mismatch without changing the worker implementations themselves.
